description.value: Budgies Burritos is a vegetarian, Tex-Mex style restaurant established in 2005, located on Kingsway in Vancouver. The kitchen makes all food from scratch daily with fresh ingredients, and every menu item can be made vegan. It's a casual dine-in or takeout spot well-suited to cyclists seeking a hearty, plant-based meal mid-ride.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an active, established vegetarian Tex-Mex restaurant at 44 Kingsway, Vancouver, with phone 604-874-5408 matching OSM. Vegan and gluten-free options are explicitly confirmed on the website ('EVERYTHING CAN BE MADE VEGAN. LOTS OF GLUTEN FREE OPTIONS TOO.'). Takeout is confirmed ('STAY IN OR TAKE OUT RESTAURANT') and Uber Delivery is mentioned. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or Wi-Fi appears in the website content, so those remain null despite OSM's internet_access=wlan tag.
concerns: Hours discrepancy: OSM records Mo-Su 11:00-00:00 (daily until midnight); website front page states MON-SATURDAY 11AM-10PM / CLOSED SUNDAYS; contact page states TUESDAY-SATURDAY 12PM-8PM. Three conflicting sets of hours suggest the business may have reduced its operating days/hours — OSM hours likely outdated.
OSM tag internet_access=wlan not corroborated by website content; Wi-Fi left null per rules.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A long-established (2005), fully vegetarian/vegan Tex-Mex restaurant with takeout and dine-in options on a major Vancouver corridor; clearly useful to touring cyclists seeking plant-based food. Required amenity details (bike parking, washrooms, water refill) should be confirmed on-site or via a follow-up call.
